1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: 
3: const { spawn } = require('child_process');
4: const { ensureBinary } = require('./download');
5: 
6: async function main() {
7:   try {
8:     // Ensure binary is downloaded
9:     const binaryPath = await ensureBinary();
10: 
11:     // Start lightpanda mcp process
12:     const lightpanda = spawn(binaryPath, ['mcp'], {
13:       stdio: 'inherit', // Pass through stdin/stdout/stderr
14:       env: process.env,
15:     });
16: 
17:     // Forward signals
18:     process.on('SIGTERM', () => lightpanda.kill('SIGTERM'));
19:     process.on('SIGINT', () => lightpanda.kill('SIGINT'));
20: 
21:     // Exit with same code as lightpanda
22:     lightpanda.on('exit', (code) => {
23:       process.exit(code || 0);
24:     });
25: 
26:     lightpanda.on('error', (err) => {
27:       console.error('Failed to start Lightpanda:', err);
28:       process.exit(1);
29:     });
30:   } catch (error) {
31:     console.error('Error:', error.message);
32:     process.exit(1);
33:   }
34: }
35: 
36: main();
